title: The man who invented brilliants (Mikhail Tal)
post: The man who invented brilliant moves… and the engine calls them blunders #chess #mikhailtal #brilliantmove #story #education

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: This man invented the brilliant move.
phrases.say: [excited] This man invented the brilliant move.

phrases.text: But an engine says his most famous sacrifices don't work.
phrases.say: [mysterious] But an engine says his most famous sacrifices... don't work.

phrases.text: Mikhail Tal. The Magician from Riga.
phrases.say: Mikhail Tal. [mischievously] The Magician from Riga.

phrases.text: Moscow, 1960. At twenty-three, he plays Botvinnik for the world title.
phrases.say: Moscow, 1960. At twenty-three, he plays Botvinnik... for the world title.

phrases.text: Outside, hundreds of fans watch on a giant board.
phrases.say: [impressed] Outside, hundreds of fans watch on a giant board.

phrases.text: Game six. Tal throws a knight away.
phrases.say: Game six. [excited] Tal throws a knight away!

phrases.text: The hall goes so wild, the game is moved to a back room.
phrases.say: [excited] The hall goes so wild... the game is moved to a back room.

phrases.text: Today, an engine finds the answer in under a second.
phrases.say: [dry] Today, an engine finds the answer... in under a second.

phrases.text: Botvinnik doesn't. Tal wins the game, then the whole match.
phrases.say: Botvinnik doesn't. [excited] Tal wins the game... then the whole match.

phrases.text: Bled, 1965. Against Larsen. The match is tied. Last game.
phrases.say: Bled, 1965. Against Larsen. [serious] The match is tied. Last game.

phrases.text: And Tal gives away a knight. Again.
phrases.say: And Tal gives away a knight... [mischievously] Again.

phrases.text: But Larsen goes wrong one move later, and Tal wins the match.
phrases.say: But Larsen goes wrong one move later... [excited] and Tal wins the match.

phrases.text: Kasparov wrote: Tal posed problems ahead of their time.
phrases.say: [impressed] Kasparov wrote... Tal posed problems ahead of their time.

phrases.text: Tal himself once said: there are two kinds of sacrifices.
phrases.say: [storytelling] Tal himself once said... there are two kinds of sacrifices.

phrases.text: So, how many brilliant moves have you played? Comment a number.
phrases.say: [curious] So... how many brilliant moves have you played? Comment a number.
